description: the generic evaluator drops the D7c bridge lag (row r no longer holds the field dated r-1), so it no longer reproduces the legacy forms
the classifier admits a cross-sectional node (standardize/rank) inside SIMPLE_G
the generator ignores the frozen seed (fresh PCG64 entropy instead), so two same-seed draws differ
the classifier admits rolling_mean(ret) as a permitted divisor
the oracle reads the TRI row label as the TRI date (bridge lag ignored), so ear uses the wrong sessions
the evaluator observes an event at K instead of K+1, so the announcement window is incomplete
B_e uses the draft's symmetric +-15 min window ([15:45, 16:15)) instead of the frozen [15:45, 16:00)
the EVENT_G classifier admits an event primitive as a divisor
